test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 01 Dec, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0bfcac15c59f017af82a92bfd7c9b117825fa6455b1950548808ad330e4d8a39.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

The bottom row elements shift clockwise subsequently.

The first two elements of first column shift interchange positions.

The rest of the positions shift clockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d142eba3d8ee89cb7ef40bc77ca7df7573973ef8dbe20946e165c480ef99669.png] 

2) Second box series →

The left diagonal corner elements interchange positions.

The right diagonal corner elements interchange positions.

The center elements of 1st column and 3rd row interchange positions.

The center elements of 1st row and 3rd column interchange positions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d460f7ac915237b73b46c2acb607daa849f0f374ce6bb33a6f4bac5b4290d8e8.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b709276ea366de5325f6ab3fb06b54f2978e9329ae9d46266d8096a722d9d4bf.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
